h1: The 6 Best Built-In Microwaves of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six built-in microwaves and drawer models, compared on size, wattage, cooking sensors and installation needs for kitchens.
summary: The Sharp SMD2420MS drawer is our best overall built-in microwave, with sensor cooking and under-counter installation. The thermomate suits those who want 11 power levels, the Frigidaire Gallery is the largest, and the COSMO fits wider cabinets.
intro: Built-in microwaves come in two very different shapes, and mixing them up is the costliest mistake in this category. A wall-oven style unit needs a trim kit and a specific cutout, while a drawer model slides in under a counter and opens like a dishwasher drawer.

We reviewed eight microwaves and ranked six that are truly designed for built-in installation, judging on listed capacity, wattage, sensor cooking, width and installation notes. Two countertop models were left out because they are not built-in units.

products.name: Sharp SMD2420MS 24-Inch Built-In Microwave Drawer Oven
products.verdict: A 24 inch under-counter drawer with sensor cooking and touch controls.
products.description:
The Sharp SMD2420MS is a 24 inch drawer microwave with 1.2 cubic feet of capacity, a touch control panel and sensor cook technology, designed for under-counter installation. A drawer keeps controls and food at a comfortable height.

It ranks first because it lists the clearest feature set for a drawer model, while the cheaper-looking rivals say little about controls. The Sharp SMD2470 below shares the footprint but has a thinner listing.

Buy it for an island or lower cabinet. The caveat is the $500 plus price tier.
products.skipIf: You want a standard door microwave.

products.name: thermomate 24 Inch Built-in Microwave Drawer
products.verdict: 1000 watts with 11 power levels, touch controls and sensor cooking.
products.description:
The thermomate is a 24 inch built-in drawer microwave rated at 1000 watts with 11 power levels, touch controls and sensor cooking.

It ranks second because the Sharp SMD2420MS lists the same sensor tech with a stronger brand name. The thermomate gives you more power levels to fine tune.

Pick it for finer control. The caveat is the $500 plus price tier and a lesser known brand.

products.name: KoolMore 24 Inch Stainless-Steel Microwave Drawer with 1.2 cu. ft.
products.verdict: 1000W with 10 cooking levels, memory and timer functions.
products.description:
The KoolMore KM-MD-1SS is a 24 inch stainless steel drawer microwave of 1.2 cubic feet with 1000W power, 10 custom cooking levels, memory and timer functions, and a wall-mounted flat bottom.

It ranks third because it has 10 power levels against the thermomate's 11 and no sensor cooking in the listing. Memory presets are the draw.

Pick it for repeat recipes. The caveat is the $500 plus price tier.

products.name: Sharp SMD2470ASY 24 in. 1.2 cu. ft. Built-In Microwave Drawer Oven
products.verdict: A 24 inch, 1.2 cubic foot Sharp drawer oven.
products.description:
The Sharp SMD2470ASY is a 24 inch, 1.2 cubic foot built-in microwave drawer oven.

It ranks fourth because the listing gives few features next to the SMD2420MS. It shares the size and brand.

Pick it if the SMD2420MS is unavailable. The caveat is thin spec detail and the $500 plus price tier.
products.idealFor: A Sharp drawer when the first is out.

products.name: COSMO 30 in. Haven Coll 1.2 cu. ft. Built-in Microwave Drawer
products.verdict: A 30 inch, 1.2 cubic foot drawer for wider cabinets.
products.description:
The COSMO Haven Collection is a 30 inch, 1.2 cubic foot built-in microwave drawer.

It ranks fifth because it needs a wider cabinet opening than the 24 inch models and lists no sensor or power detail. Width is its distinction.

Pick it for a 30 inch opening. The caveat is thin specs and the $500 plus price tier.

products.name: Frigidaire Gallery Series GMBS3068BF 2.2 cu. ft. Built-in Microwave
products.verdict: A 2.2 cubic foot built-in, with the trim kit sold separately.
products.description:
The Frigidaire Gallery GMBS3068BF is a 2.2 cubic foot built-in microwave, with the trim kit sold separately.

It ranks last because the trim kit adds cost and the listing lists little else. The capacity is the biggest here.

Pick it for a wall cabinet and big dishes. The caveat is buying the trim kit.
products.idealFor: Large dishes in a wall cabinet.

whatMatters.detail: A drawer microwave opens like a cabinet drawer and sits low, while a door model sits at eye level. Drawers are easier on reach but cost more. Check the title for the word drawer.
Built-in units are sized for 24 or 30 inch openings. Measure your cutout before ordering. The listing size is the exact fit.
Some door models need a separate trim kit to look finished. Without it you get gaps. Check the listing for trim kit notes.
Wattage affects cooking speed, with 1000 to 1200W typical. Look for the number in the specs.
Sensors adjust time based on steam. They help with reheating. Check the bullets for sensor cook.

cards.label: Drawer
cards.text: Low and easy to reach. The Sharp, thermomate, KoolMore and COSMO are drawers.

cards.label: Door
cards.text: Classic placement with a trim kit. The Frigidaire Gallery fits here.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to a drawer if the cabinet allows.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A under-counter drawer with touch controls.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Sharp SMD2420MS is listed for under-counter installation.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want sensor cooking in the Sharp SMD2420MS.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You only reheat, where the Frigidaire Gallery is enough.

faq.a: One designed to sit in a cabinet or wall opening instead of on the counter.
Ordering before measuring the cutout. Sizes are fixed.

faq.q: Is a drawer worth it over a door model?
faq.a: For comfort, yes, but you pay more.

faq.q: Do I need a trim kit?
faq.a: The Frigidaire Gallery lists one sold separately.
Follow the maker's cutout and ventilation notes, and use a pro.

faq.q: Can I put a countertop microwave in the opening?
faq.a: Not safely. Built-in units are made for the ventilation of a cabinet.

finalTake: The Sharp SMD2420MS is the built-in microwave most kitchens should buy. The thermomate suits fine control, the KoolMore memory presets, the COSMO wider cabinets, and the Frigidaire the largest dishes. Measure the opening first.
